_comment: Generated by tools/sync-golem-fx-manifest.py from golem-fx (plugin.rs + gfx-bench manifest). Do not edit. Keyed by VST3 class id (hex), as in effects-golem-engine.json. Ranges are plain and linear; `n` = option count of an enum. Read by golem_rig.lua (golem-fx under REAPER).

model.name: Model
model.help: The body; owns its modes, high band, decay and K

body.name: Body
body.help: The body's resonances (the boom, the breath): 50 % = the model's own, ±12 dB

top.name: Top
top.help: Attack and sparkle, and the trim for a guitar that is not the pickup guess: 50 % = the model's own

mic.name: Mic
mic.help: Microphone blend: 0 bridge, 50 sound hole, 100 neck (12th – 14th fret)

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Law: linear crossfade, 0 = the DI, 100 = the acoustic

twelve.name: 12-String
twelve.help: Adds the octave and unison courses

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.help: The guitar's pickup, so its EMF can be rebuilt from the DI (golem sets it at insert)

size.name: Size
size.help: Body scale: every mode at f · 100 / size

decay.name: Decay
decay.help: Shortens the electric's sustain as an acoustic body drains the strings: 50 % = the model's own, 0 = off

piezo.name: Piezo Blend
piezo.help: Adds an under-saddle piezo voice to the mic: the stage sound

quack.name: Quack Cut
quack.help: Piezo source only: tames the piezo's mid peak on the attacks

low_cut.name: Low Cut
low_cut.help: 2-pole high-pass after the body: band mix, feedback

room.name: Room
room.help: The small room around the mic

width.name: Width
width.help: 2 / 2 only: the spacing of the two microphones

twelve_level.name: Courses Level
twelve_level.help: Octave and unison strings relative to the main courses

twelve_delay.name: Strum Offset
twelve_delay.help: Delay of the course voices on top of the shifter's 3 ms centre and the octave bands' own 5 – 9 ms

level.name: Level
level.help: 0 dB = the bypass loudness on every model

wah.name: Sensitivity
wah.help: Envelope window: higher = reacts to softer playing

type.name: Type
type.help: Default Wah: golem's autowah block played GxAutoWah, an envelope-driven Cry Baby; presets keep that sound

poles.name: Poles
poles.help: Filter slope: 2 poles = vocal, 4 poles = deeper, synth-like

direction.name: Direction
direction.help: Up = louder notes sweep upward; Down = they sweep downward

peak.name: Peak
peak.help: Resonance of the filter: higher = a sharper, more vocal peak

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: How fast the sweep follows a picked note

release.name: Release
release.help: How fast the sweep falls back after the note

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level against the dry signal (100 % = filter only)

level.name: Level
level.help: Check plain ↔ normalized on REAPER (negative minimum)

source.name: Source
source.help: What moves the filter: playing dynamics, an LFO, sample and hold, or both

rate.name: Rate
rate.help: Speed of the LFO or sample-and-hold source

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the LFO to the host tempo; Off = the Rate control

gain.name: Drive
gain.help: Gain into the model's stages, linear in dB over the model's own range; loudness-compensated

mix.name: Blend
mix.help: Law: linear crossfade, 0 = clean only, 100 = dirt only; phase-coherent

model.name: Model
model.help: Modern: CMOS grind; Classic: tube-emulation DI push; Vintage: valve-preamp grit

cab.name: Cab
cab.help: Speaker emulation; Off for an amp, a cab or an IR after it

grunt.name: Grunt
grunt.help: Lows into the clipper (pre-clip low shelf at 4 × low_note), added to the model's own

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: Treble into the clipper (pre-clip high shelf at 1.5 kHz), added to the model's own

dirt_level.name: Dirt Level
dirt_level.help: The dirt's level relative to the compensated level (the hardware Level knob)

lo_mid_freq.name: Lo Mid Freq
lo_mid_freq.help: Centre of the Lo Mid band (the hardware positions: 250, 500, 1,000 Hz)

hi_mid_freq.name: Hi Mid Freq
hi_mid_freq.help: Centre of the Hi Mid band, the growl (the hardware positions: 750, 1,500, 3,000 Hz)

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Below this frequency the bass stays clean, mono and out of the clipper (0 = off)

low_note.name: Lowest Note
low_note.help: The lowest open string: golem sets it from the lane's tuning; every low corner follows it

comp_path.name: Comp Path
comp_path.help: Dirt: compress the driven path only; Both: compress before the clean / dirt split

sag.name: Sag
sag.help: 50 % = the model's own sag; 0 = none, 100 % = double (no effect in Modern)

input.name: Input
input.help: Instrument level into the box (active / passive); not compensated

cab_lows.name: Cab Lows
cab_lows.help: Off: the speaker emulation acts only above the bass

polarity.name: Polarity
polarity.help: Fixes a phase problem between two lanes

highcut.name: High Cut
highcut.help: Fizz control; a dark lead sweep

align.name: Align
align.help: Leading-delay trim and auto-polarity; B aligned to A by correlation

delay_b.name: Delay B
delay_b.help: Fine phase: + delays B, − delays A

length.name: Length
length.help: IR trim; ≥ the IR's length = untouched

fade.name: Fade
fade.help: Half-Hann fade over the end of a trimmed IR

normalize.name: Normalize
normalize.help: Level match between IRs, at the level of a typical cab IR played raw

min_phase.name: Min Phase
min_phase.help: Minimum-phase transform (tight, no pre-delay, easy blends)

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Shared id: below it the dry plays instead of the cab

stereo.name: Stereo
stereo.help: 2 / 2 only: same blend both sides, or A left / B right (as Linked while B is none)

profile.name: Profile
profile.help: Picks the voicing: anchors of every group, internal scale of Depth and Warmth

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Voice topology and its reference settings

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: Peak-to-peak swing of the delay (catalogue chorus.depth: 1 – 8 ms, same meaning)

warmth.name: Warmth
warmth.help: Colour macro: wet low-pass, input saturation, BBD bandwidth and noise, in the profile's proportions

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level, dry at unity — the catalogue's law (golem forces Calf's dry to 1.0); 1.0 = wet as loud as dry (a CE-2's 50 / 50)

xover_freq.name: Crossover Freq
xover_freq.help: Below this frequency: dry signal, summed to mono

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Soft saturation of the input stage (wet only)

bbd_chip.name: BBD Chip
bbd_chip.help: Stage count: sets the clock frequency and so the aliasing

bbd_bw.name: BBD Bandwidth
bbd_bw.help: Cut-off of the anti-aliasing and reconstruction filters

emphasis.name: Emphasis
emphasis.help: BBD pre-emphasis before the line and matching de-emphasis after (CE-2: ≈ +15 dB treble shelf); lowers hiss, shapes the BBD's distortion

compander.name: Compander
compander.help: NE570-style compression/expansion (Dimension D): pumping, breathing noise

noise.name: Noise
noise.help: Hiss and clock bleed (BBD), tape hiss (Tape)

mod_custom.name: Modulation Custom
mod_custom.help: Off = follows the profile and the mode

delay_base.name: Base Delay
delay_base.help: Centre delay the modulation swings around

lfo_shape.name: LFO Shape
lfo_shape.help: Triangle is RC-smoothed like the CE-2's (no corner in pitch); Rounded = softer; Random = smoothed random; Log = Strymon "dBucket"-style log LFO

voices.name: Voices
voices.help: Used by Ensemble and Doubler; fixed by the other modes

voice_spread.name: Voice Spread
voice_spread.help: LFO phase offset between successive voices

imperfection.name: Imperfection
imperfection.help: Analogue tolerances: phase and amplitude errors between voices, curved control voltage (string ensembles)

detune_lock.name: Detune Lock
detune_lock.help: Holds the peak pitch deviation constant when Rate changes (depth shrinks as rate rises)

drift.name: Drift
drift.help: Slow random detuning of rate and depth between voices ("human")

crossmix.name: Cross-Mix
crossmix.help: L/R cross-mix of the complementary voices (Dimension mode)

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.help: Feedback; above ~30 % it drifts towards a flanger

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the LFO to the host tempo

env_depth.name: Env → Depth
env_depth.help: Playing harder adds (+) or removes (−) depth

env_mix.name: Env → Mix
env_mix.help: Playing harder raises (+) or ducks (−) the wet: chords stay clear on the attack, the chorus blooms on the sustain

stereo_phase.name: Stereo Phase
stereo_phase.help: LFO offset between left and right

mono_safe.name: Mono Safe
mono_safe.help: Complementary voices built so that the mono sum does not hollow out

wet_lpf.name: Wet High Cut
wet_lpf.help: Low-pass on the wet; Warmth moves it around this anchor

mix_law.name: Mix Law
mix_law.help: Add = dry at unity + wet × mix (catalogue); Crossfade = (1 − mix) dry + mix wet (1.0 = vibrato); Equal Power = constant level

level_comp.name: Level Comp
level_comp.help: Static gain computed from mix, the law and the voice count (never from the signal: nothing pumps), so on / off sounds equally loud

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Level above which the compressor starts to reduce gain

ratio.name: Ratio
ratio.help: How much the level above the threshold is reduced (30:1 ≈ limiting)

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: How fast gain reduction sets in once the level exceeds the threshold

release.name: Release
release.help: With auto_release: the fast stage, the slow one follows

character.name: Character
character.help: The compressor's voicing: clean, bus glue, FET, opto or pedal

knee.name: Knee
knee.help: Quadratic soft knee in dB, the same in every character

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Parallel compression; the dry runs through the same oversampling path when it is active, so the blend never combs

link.name: Stereo Link
link.help: Stereo layout: 100 = one gain for both channels

corr.name: Correction
corr.help: Share of the pitch error removed

filter.name: Filter
filter.help: How tightly a held note is kept (one-pole time constant)

transition.name: Transition
transition.help: How fast a new note is caught

vibrato.name: Vibrato
vibrato.help: The singer's vibrato through the correction: 0 % = treated as error (removed as far as filter allows), 100 % = kept intact even at filter 0, 200 % = doubled

fastmode.name: Fast Correction
fastmode.help: On = Live (4.3 – 9.3 ms); off = Studio (PSOLA, exact formants, 17 – 37 ms, corrected from the first cycle)

offset.name: Offset
offset.help: Constant shift added to the correction; with corr 0, a plain transposition

flex.name: Flex
flex.help: Leaves far-off pitches alone: at 100 %, 15 ¢ off is pulled fully, 60 ¢ + is left as sung (bends, blue notes)

hysteresis.name: Note Hold
hysteresis.help: How far past the midpoint the held note is kept (x42's bias 0.5 = 23 ¢)

formant_keep.name: Formant Keep
formant_keep.help: Studio: keeps the vowel's formants when shifting (PSOLA); off = formants move with the pitch (x42)

register.name: Register
register.help: Voice range (60 – 500 · 90 – 800 · 150 – 1,200 Hz); sets the Live latency

sens.name: Sensitivity
sens.help: Voicing thresholds (gfx-golem): higher corrects rougher, breathier notes, at more risk

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Under this input level, no correction (offset only): stage bleed is never retuned

m00.name: C
m00.help: Note mask: C allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m01.name: C#
m01.help: Note mask: C# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m02.name: D
m02.help: Note mask: D allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m03.name: D#
m03.help: Note mask: D# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m04.name: E
m04.help: Note mask: E allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m05.name: F
m05.help: Note mask: F allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m06.name: F#
m06.help: Note mask: F# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m07.name: G
m07.help: Note mask: G allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m08.name: G#
m08.help: Note mask: G# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m09.name: A
m09.help: Note mask: A allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m10.name: A#
m10.help: Note mask: A# allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

m11.name: B
m11.help: Note mask: B allowed as a target (intersected with key / scale; written by golem's compile)

quant.name: Quant
quant.help: Word size of the virtual converter; fractional for Linear (a sweep has no steps)

rate.name: Rate
rate.help: The virtual clock; 48,000 (or R ≥ fs) = Off

nonlin.name: Non-Lin
nonlin.help: The DAC's power-law curve (thickening), level-neutral at −18 dBFS

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Dry ↔ wet linear crossfade (parallel crush)

law.name: Format
law.help: Word format: uniform, companded or gain-ranging words

quantizer.name: Quantizer
quantizer.help: Where zero sits: silence stays silent / buzzes / dead zone (MDA)

dither.name: Dither
dither.help: TPDF, 100 % = ±1 LSB; tails fade it too

tails.name: Tails
tails.help: Below 1 – 2 LSB: unquantised tail / silence / as is

input.name: Input
input.help: Drive into the converter (clip, use of bits); output compensated

asym.name: Asymmetry
asym.help: Share of nonlin applied to one polarity only (even harmonics)

ladder.name: DAC Error
ladder.help: R-2R bit-weight mismatch: grit on quiet signals (Linear, Float)

rate_shift.name: Rate Shift
rate_shift.help: Transposes the clock down (R = rate · 2^(st / 12)): the EXP sweep control, pitch-like feel

jitter.name: Jitter
jitter.help: Clock jitter, ±25 % of a period at 100 % (seeded)

track.name: Track
track.help: Rate locked to N × the played pitch: aliases on the harmonic series (best at R ≤ 8 kHz)

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the rate LFO to the host tempo (Off: Mod Rate sets it)

env_sens.name: Envelope Sensitivity
env_sens.help: How strongly the playing level drives the rate modulation

env_att.name: Envelope Attack
env_att.help: How fast the envelope follows a rising level

env_rel.name: Envelope Release
env_rel.help: How fast the envelope falls back after a note

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Relative: band − full band; Absolute: band level

freq.name: Frequency
freq.help: Start of the detection band; corner of the shelf / centre of the bell

listen.name: Listen
listen.help: Solo of what the detector hears

detect.name: Detection
detect.help: Absolute = the JSFX's behaviour, the default so golem presets keep their meaning (rack session's advice); Relative = level-independent

shape.name: Shape
shape.help: How the sibilance is cut: high shelf, narrow bell or wide band

focus.name: Focus
focus.help: Vocal adds the zero-crossing confidence weight; Allround = pure high-frequency limiter (guitar de-harsh, cymbals)

ratio.name: Ratio
ratio.help: The JSFX's fixed ratio, now a parameter

time.name: Time
time.help: Note value at the host tempo (fallback 120 BPM); Free = time_ms

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level, dry at unity: linear wet gain = mix / 100 (golem's pct_db law, kept)

model.name: Model
model.help: The delay medium: digital, tape, bucket-brigade or lo-fi

low_cut.name: Low Cut
low_cut.help: In the loop: each repeat thinner

high_cut.name: High Cut
high_cut.help: In the loop, on top of the model's own roll-off: each repeat darker

drive.name: Drive
drive.help: Extra saturation into the loop, on top of the model's own (Echoplex preamp idea)

mod.name: Modulation
mod.help: 50 % = the model's own wow / flutter / chorus; 0 = none; 100 = exaggerated

diffusion.name: Diffusion
diffusion.help: Allpass smear in the loop: repeats blur into a wash (ambient, EchoBoy / Valhalla)

taps.name: Taps
taps.help: Extra playback taps before the feedback point

direction.name: Direction
direction.help: Reverse: each repeat plays backwards, in windows of one delay time, crossfaded at the seams

loop_pitch.name: Loop Pitch
loop_pitch.help: A pitch shifter in the loop: each repeat climbs or falls (crystal delays at +12, shimmer delay at +7 / +12, detuned repeats at ±0.1)

loop_shift.name: Loop Freq Shift
loop_shift.help: A frequency shifter in the loop (±50 Hz, log): repeats drift inharmonically (Valhalla "Ghost"); small values = barber-pole phasing echoes

age.name: Age
age.help: Wear of the medium, per model: Tape = more wow, dropouts, crinkle, treble loss; BBD = more clock noise and compander pumping; Lo-Fi = lower rate and bits;…

swell.name: Swell
swell.help: Auto volume swell into the delay: pick attacks removed from the repeats (pad delays)

sweep.name: Loop Filter Sweep
sweep.help: A slow LFO on the loop's band-pass: each repeat filtered differently (Timeline "Filter")

duck_thresh.name: Duck Threshold
duck_thresh.help: Playing level above which the repeats duck

duck_release.name: Duck Release
duck_release.help: How fast the repeats bloom back

ratio.name: Dual Ratio
ratio.help: Right delay time as a multiple of the left one (Dual stereo mode)

width.name: Width
width.help: Stereo width of the repeats (the dry stays as it is)

hold.name: Hold
hold.help: Freeze: input muted, loop gain 1, saturation bypassed

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: Bypass switch that lets the repeats ring out when Trails is on

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: When bypassed, let the repeats already in the loop fade out naturally

detune.name: Detune
detune.help: 0 … ± 25 cents (to check against GxDetune's range in its source)

voices.name: Voices
voices.help: 2 = one up, one down (± detune), panned when stereo

gain.name: Gain
gain.help: The circuit's gain pot, by rotation, with its real taper (Blend OD: both gangs, so the clean fades as the gain rises)

tone_stack.name: Tone
tone_stack.help: The circuit's tone pot by rotation, 0 % = darkest on every circuit

level.name: Level
level.help: Output; 0 dB = unity loudness at the defaults on every circuit

diodes.name: Clippers
diodes.help: Swaps the clipping devices in place (the classic mods)

opamp.name: Op-Amp
opamp.help: The macromodel of the circuit's gain-stage op-amp(s); linear stamps and followers are not touched

supply.name: Supply
supply.help: Relative to the circuit's own supply (9 V; the Blend OD's pumped rails follow; the Discrete OD's 8 V): headroom, bias, rails

hp.name: HP Mode
hp.help: MOSFET OD's HP / LP switch (22 kΩ across the 33 kΩ: louder, brighter); inert on the other circuits

tight.name: Tight
tight.help: Shared id: first-order high-pass at the circuit's input, on top of its own filters; bypassed at 20 Hz

input.name: Input
input.help: Input trim, for a source hotter or weaker than a pickup at 0 dBFS = 1 V

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Shared id: below it the signal skips the clipping

ceiling.name: Ceiling
ceiling.help: Clip threshold and driven output level

voice.name: Voice
voice.help: The clipping circuit: overdrive, distortion, fuzz or golem's legacy curve

tight.name: Tight
tight.help: Extra pre-clip high-pass on top of the voice's own (metal: 150 – 300 Hz)

asym.name: Asymmetry
asym.help: Bias into the shaper (even harmonics, sputter), DC-blocked after

sag.name: Sag
sag.help: Hard hits lower the gain and move the bias

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Below it: clean only (a bass keeps its fundamental)

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: What drives the duck: the key's level, the key's onsets, or the beat

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Peak level of the filtered key where ducking starts

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: Full duck, a positive amount in dB, whatever the key's level above threshold + knee

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: Time to reach full depth (raised-cosine edge)

hold.name: Hold
hold.help: Stays ducked this long after the key drops: bridges the gaps between words

release.name: Release
release.help: Return from full depth to 0 dB

lpf.name: Key High Cut
lpf.help: Butterworth low-pass on the key (range widened from 500 Hz when coded: the kick settings use 150 Hz)

knee.name: Knee
knee.help: Key range over which the duck grows from 0 to depth

freq.name: Band Frequency
freq.help: Bell centre; Low / High: where half the duck applies

spread.name: Spectral Spread
spread.help: Spectral: how far below the key's loudest band a band still ducks

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Trigger: the dip's length as a note value

length.name: Dip Length
length.help: Share of the note value the dip lasts (sync on)

tension.name: Recovery Tension
tension.help: Recovery shape: + returns late (club pump), − snaps back

offset.name: Beat Offset
offset.help: Pump: shifts the dip within the period to sit on the kick

sens.name: Trigger Sensitivity
sens.help: Trigger: the rise an onset needs, 12 → 3 dB (gfx-swell's detector A; same direction as gfx-killswitch)

lookahead.name: Lookahead
lookahead.help: Delays the main, reported to the host

force.name: Duck Now
force.help: Momentary footswitch: ducks fully while held (talkback, breakdown)

gain.name: Gain
gain.help: The drive pot (audio taper): clean mid boost at the bottom, a mid-range push above ~40 %

tone_stack.name: Tone
tone_stack.help: The 808 tone network: darkest at 0, the mid hump at half, presence above

level.name: Level
level.help: Output level; 0 dB = the hardware level pot fully up

headroom.name: Headroom
headroom.help: Clip knee relative to the MOSFET pair: −13 dB ≈ a Tube Screamer's diodes

asym.name: Asymmetry
asym.help: Lowers the negative knee (up to −50 %): an unmatched pair, even harmonics

tight.name: Tight
tight.help: Extra high-pass in the gain leg, on top of the 720 Hz; bypassed at 20 Hz

input.name: Input
input.help: Input trim, for a source hotter or weaker than a pickup at 0 dBFS = 1 V

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Below it: clean, so a bass keeps its fundamental

lowcut.name: Low Cut
lowcut.help: High-pass filter: removes the lows below this frequency

midgain.name: Mid Gain
midgain.help: Boost or cut of the mid bell

midfreq.name: Mid Freq
midfreq.help: Bell frequency (an EXP sweep = a fixed wah)

midprop.name: Proportional Q
midprop.help: 0 = constant Q; 100 = API-like narrowing with gain

mid2gain.name: Mid 2 Gain
mid2gain.help: Second bell: a guitarist's commonest move is two at once (cut the mud, lift the presence)

mid2freq.name: Mid 2 Freq
mid2freq.help: Centre frequency of the second mid band

mid2q.name: Mid 2 Q
mid2q.help: Same proportional-Q amount as the first bell

highfreq.name: High Freq
highfreq.help: High shelf corner (ReaEQ's band 4 value to read on the bench)

airfreq.name: Air Freq
airfreq.help: Corner frequency of the air shelf

highcut.name: High Cut
highcut.help: Low-pass, 12 dB / oct, matched (no forced zero at Nyquist)

harsh_freq.name: De-harsh Freq
harsh_freq.help: Centre of the band the de-harsher watches and tames

harsh_thresh.name: De-harsh Threshold
harsh_thresh.help: Band level relative to the full band

harsh_range.name: De-harsh Range
harsh_range.help: Maximum cut the de-harsher may apply

rate.name: Rate
rate.help: Speed of the sweep (when Sync is Off)

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: The flanger voicing: classic pedals, tape through-zero, barber-pole or pedal-controlled

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: Exponential span between manual and length

fb_polarity.name: Feedback Polarity
fb_polarity.help: Sign of the feedback: + = metallic peaks, − = hollow notches

shape.name: LFO Shape
shape.help: Mode = the mode's own shape; Random = smoothed S&H, fixed seed

sweep_src.name: Sweep Source
sweep_src.help: What sweeps the delay: the LFO, playing dynamics, the Manual control, or LFO and dynamics

env_sens.name: Envelope Sensitivity
env_sens.help: Level at which playing dynamics start to move the sweep

env_att.name: Envelope Attack
env_att.help: How fast the envelope follows a louder note

env_rel.name: Envelope Release
env_rel.help: How fast the envelope falls back after the note

stereo_phase.name: Stereo Phase
stereo_phase.help: LFO offset between left and right (180° = opposite sweeps)

fb_hpf.name: Loop Low Cut
fb_hpf.help: High-pass in the feedback loop: keeps the lows from building up

fb_lpf.name: Loop High Cut
fb_lpf.help: Low-pass in the feedback loop: softens the resonance

formant.name: Formant
formant.help: Moves the envelope: below 0 bigger and darker (giant), above smaller and lighter (child, chipmunk)

growl.name: Growl
growl.help: Alternate periods attenuated, plus roughness: a growl at f0 / 2

vowel.name: Vowel
vowel.help: Vowel template position a · e · i · o · u (0, 25, 50, 75, 100 %)

vowel_amt.name: Vowel Amount
vowel_amt.help: 0 = the input's own formants (moved); 100 % = replaced by the vowel (talk-box)

shift.name: Pitch
shift.help: Pitch change, Grain only: the descriptor carries depends: engine = Grain, so golem greys it in Live, and Live ignores it

source.name: Source
source.help: Voice: window and envelope detail from the sung pitch, unvoiced handling

unvoiced.name: Unvoiced Shift
unvoiced.help: Share of the formant shift applied to consonants and breath (noise-like frames; never chords)

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.help: Source tilt around 1 kHz, clamped ±12 dB

breath.name: Breath
breath.help: Aspiration noise shaped by the new envelope

thresh.name: Threshold
thresh.help: Below it the envelope is held and Grain's gate closes (gfx-golem's id)

lookahead.name: Lookahead
lookahead.help: Live only: delays the audio to centre the analysis; reported as latency, rounded to whole samples

mix.name: Mix

max_time.name: Max Hold
max_time.help: Longest bloom or hold, from the start of Rise; 60 = no limit

duck.name: Duck
duck.help: The dry (and the held partials in Both) gives way as the feedback blooms: the note turns into its harmonic

color.name: Color
color.help: Harmonics of the feedback tone; 50 % = the model's pickup voicing, 0 = pure sine

tone.name: Tone
tone.help: Sustain: tilt of the held partials, ±6 dB per octave of partial number; 0 = the note's own body spectrum, − = mellower (a magnetic sustainer's sound)

lowest.name: Lowest Note
lowest.help: Detector floor: 70 Hz guitar, 35 Hz bass

thresh.name: Noise Floor
thresh.help: Nothing below it starts a note; a partial 6 dB below it is no longer followed (its pitch is held)

source.name: Detector Source
source.help: Key = the auxiliary input (the clean DI when placed after the amp)

trails.name: Trails
trails.help: On: bypass releases the bloom over release

rise.name: Rise
rise.help: Swell time from start to full level (when sync = Off)

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Rise as a note value at the host tempo

sens.name: Sensitivity
sens.help: Pick threshold (rise 12 → 3 dB) and the window below the playing level that may trigger (18 → 48 dB)

legato.name: Legato
legato.help: Sensitivity of the pickless detectors (shape flux, pitch jump); 0 = picks only (and cheaper)

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: How far below unity a swell starts: 100 % = from silence, 50 % = attack softened by 6 dB

dip.name: Retrigger Dip
dip.help: How far a new note pulls a ringing note down before swelling; 0 = swell only after silence

strum.name: Strum Window
strum.help: Onsets this close to the first one merge into one swell (strums, slides); also the fastest retrigger

decay.name: Decay (Bow)
decay.help: After the rise, fall back to the start level: attack-decay bows, reverse-tape

reset.name: Reset
reset.help: The swell resets (gain back to the start) once the note has decayed this far below its body level; falling under thresh always resets

release.name: Reset Fade
release.help: Fade to the start level on reset

thresh.name: Noise Floor
thresh.help: Absolute floor: nothing below it triggers or holds a note (hiss, hum)

source.name: Detector Source
source.help: Key = the auxiliary input (the clean DI when the swell sits after the amp)

lookahead.name: Lookahead
lookahead.help: Delays the audio, reported to the host: perfect removal of retriggered attacks

fire.name: Fire
fire.help: Each off → on edge starts a swell (footswitch)

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: The VST3 bypass parameter (make_bypass): golem switches the block with it, so engaging is seen

input.name: Record
input.help: How hard the tape is hit: 0 dB puts a -18 dBFS note at the machine's reference; the output stays level

wow.name: Wow
wow.help: Peak slow speed deviation (% of speed); the model sets its spectrum

flutter.name: Flutter
flutter.help: Peak fast speed deviation (% of speed), 4 - 200 Hz

wear.name: Wear
wear.help: Age and failures in the model's own way: dull heads, dropouts, crinkles, snags or crackle

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Dry ↔ wet crossfade, dry aligned (50 % + wow = tape chorus)

speed.name: Speed
speed.help: Tape speed: losses, bump, EQ, transport scale; inert on Vinyl / Shellac / Radio

bias.name: Bias
bias.help: Under 100 %: crossover grit and a brighter top; over: cleaner and darker

head_bump.name: Head Bump
head_bump.help: Contour effect, relative to the model's

spacing.name: Spacing
spacing.help: Head-to-tape gap: highs vanish first, much more at low speed

azimuth.name: Azimuth
azimuth.help: Head tilt in arc-minutes: duller highs; in stereo a delay between the tracks

wow_rate.name: Wow Speed
wow_rate.help: Scales the speed of every slow wobble of the transport

wow_rand.name: Wow Randomness
wow_rand.help: Negative: a regular, machine-like wobble; positive: erratic

drop_sync.name: Dropout Sync
drop_sync.help: Puts the dropouts on the host grid (Off: random)

noise_mode.name: Noise Mode
noise_mode.help: Follow: noise only under the playing; Constant: always; Duck: in the gaps

mech.name: Mechanical
mech.help: Relative to the model's motor / rumble noise

stop.name: Stop
stop.help: Tape stop: the motor winds down; off spins it back up

stop_time.name: Stop Time
stop_time.help: Stop ramp; spin-up = ¼ of it

spread.name: Spread
spread.help: Stereo: the random wobble and failures differ left and right

attack.name: Attack
attack.help: Gain on a full transient; + = more punch, − = softer

sustain.name: Sustain
sustain.help: Gain on the tail once it has decayed; + = longer ring, − = tighter

att_time.name: Attack Length
att_time.help: How long the attack gain lasts

sus_time.name: Sustain Length
sus_time.help: Which notes count as decaying: the reference falls at 8.69 / length dB / s

sens.name: Sensitivity
sens.help: The level jump (attack) or fall under the reference (sustain) that counts as full: D_ref = 22 → 2 dB, above a fixed 1.5 dB dead zone

smooth.name: Smooth
smooth.help: Time the gain takes to move into an attack (and the lookahead ramp)

sc_hpf.name: Sidechain Low Cut
sc_hpf.help: Detector high-pass; also sets W (40 ms up to 60 Hz, 20 ms at 120 Hz, 8 ms from 300 Hz): shorter hold, faster sustain response

thresh.name: Noise Floor
thresh.help: Absolute floor: nothing below is shaped, sustain never lifts toward it

source.name: Detector Source
source.help: Key = auxiliary input (the clean DI after an amp)

lookahead.name: Lookahead
lookahead.help: Reported latency; the gain arrives before the transient

ceiling.name: Ceiling Level
ceiling.help: Maximum output level for ceil_mode Soft / Limit

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Linear crossfade dry / shaped (dry delay-aligned)

delta.name: Delta
delta.help: Outputs only what the shaper adds or removes (wet − dry)

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: VST3 bypass parameter (make_bypass), as the coded effects

rate.name: Rate
rate.help: Speed of the volume modulation (when Sync is Off)

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: Trough gain = 1 − depth; lamp drive in Optical / Neon

model.name: Model
model.help: The tremolo circuit: clean VCA, valve bias, optical cell, neon or harmonic (two bands in opposition)

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the rate to the host tempo; Off = the Rate control

xover.name: Crossover
xover.help: Split frequency of the Harmonic model's two bands

level.name: Level
level.help: Makeup (a tremolo lowers the average level)

tuning.name: Tuning
tuning.help: The open strings: string-aware attribution, harmonics, poly

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Auto switches to Poly on a strum

precision.name: Precision
precision.help: Fast: window up to 24 periods, settled when the readings hold within 0.2 ¢ (error ≤ 0.3 ¢)

mute.name: Mute
mute.help: Output muted (10 ms ramp) while the tuner is engaged

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.help: On = the tuner is put away: audio passes bit-exact; analysis stops unless always_on

transpose.name: Transpose
transpose.help: Shifts every string target: capo (+), down-tuned or "flat ×n" (−)

offset_1.name: Offset 1
offset_1.help: Sweetening of string 1 in cents (1 = the lowest), its 12th-fret harmonic included

offset_2.name: Offset 2
offset_2.help: Sweetening of string 2 in cents (1 = the lowest), its 12th-fret harmonic included

offset_3.name: Offset 3
offset_3.help: Sweetening of string 3 in cents (1 = the lowest), its 12th-fret harmonic included

offset_4.name: Offset 4
offset_4.help: Sweetening of string 4 in cents (1 = the lowest), its 12th-fret harmonic included

offset_5.name: Offset 5
offset_5.help: Sweetening of string 5 in cents (1 = the lowest), its 12th-fret harmonic included

offset_6.name: Offset 6
offset_6.help: Sweetening of string 6 in cents (1 = the lowest), its 12th-fret harmonic included

offset_7.name: Offset 7
offset_7.help: Sweetening of string 7 in cents (1 = the lowest), its 12th-fret harmonic included

offset_8.name: Offset 8
offset_8.help: Sweetening of string 8 in cents (1 = the lowest), its 12th-fret harmonic included

string_1.name: String 1
string_1.help: Custom tuning's open string 1 (MIDI, 1 = the lowest); 0 ends the list

string_2.name: String 2
string_2.help: Custom tuning's open string 2 (MIDI, 1 = the lowest); 0 ends the list

string_3.name: String 3
string_3.help: Custom tuning's open string 3 (MIDI, 1 = the lowest); 0 ends the list

string_4.name: String 4
string_4.help: Custom tuning's open string 4 (MIDI, 1 = the lowest); 0 ends the list

string_5.name: String 5
string_5.help: Custom tuning's open string 5 (MIDI, 1 = the lowest); 0 ends the list

string_6.name: String 6
string_6.help: Custom tuning's open string 6 (MIDI, 1 = the lowest); 0 ends the list

string_7.name: String 7
string_7.help: Custom tuning's open string 7 (MIDI, 1 = the lowest); 0 ends the list

string_8.name: String 8
string_8.help: Custom tuning's open string 8 (MIDI, 1 = the lowest); 0 ends the list

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.help: Level below which nothing is read (noisy rigs, hum)

always_on.name: Always On
always_on.help: Keep measuring while bypassed: drift badge during a song (PolyTune's "Display Always On")

depth.name: Depth
depth.help: 0 – 100 cents (Clean, BBD); stage swing (Varistor, Vibe); V1 → V3 (Scanner)

speed.name: Speed
speed.help: Speed of the pitch modulation (when Sync is Off)

model.name: Model
model.help: The vibrato circuit: clean delay, BBD, varistor, Uni-Vibe-style or organ scanner

shape.name: Shape
shape.help: Random = smoothed, fixed seed, with LFO wobble

tone.name: Tone
tone.help: Low-pass after the vibrato: darker as it rises

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: 0.5 = chorus (Hammond C modes, Uni-Vibe chorus)

sync.name: Sync
sync.help: Locks the speed to the host tempo; Off = the Speed control

level.name: Level
level.help: Output; GxTubeVibrato plays ~6.6 dB louder than unity (golem-rack, pink noise): golem can pin it at insert for preset continuity

source.name: Carrier
source.help: What the voice is imposed on

chord.name: Chord
chord.help: Tracked and Drone: notes stacked diatonically in key / scale

formant.name: Formant
formant.help: Moves the voice's formants without moving the pitch: + smaller and brighter, − bigger and darker

env_rel.name: Release
env_rel.help: How long a band rings after the voice leaves it

sib.name: Sibilance
sib.help: The voice's own highs above the bank, full on "s / t / f", −12 dB during vowels, gated with the voice

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Equal-power crossfade, dry (the main input) to vocoded

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.help: Holds the current vowel; the carrier keeps playing

spacing.name: Spacing
spacing.help: ERB puts resolution where speech is understood (1 – 4 kHz); Log is the analog layout

high.name: High
high.help: Centre of the highest band; the sibilance pass starts here

width.name: Width
width.help: Band width relative to the flattest one for this band count

thresh.name: Gate
thresh.help: Below it the modulator is treated as silence (mic bleed), sibilance path included

flatten.name: Flatten
flatten.help: Removes the carrier's own spectral tilt so the voice's spectrum comes through

unvoiced.name: Unvoiced
unvoiced.help: Carrier replaced by noise during unvoiced sounds (the EMS switch), and at a phrase start until the pitch is known

noise.name: Noise
noise.help: Noise always added to the carrier: breath, and highs for a dark carrier

register.name: Register
register.help: Tracked: the range the pitch is searched in

quantize.name: Quantize
quantize.help: Tracked root: as sung · nearest semitone (robot steps) · nearest note of the key

glide.name: Glide
glide.help: Tracked root portamento (gfx-octaver's id and range)

degree.name: Degree
degree.help: Drone: the scale degree the chord stands on (five-note scales: 6 and 7 = 1 and 2 an octave up)

key.name: Key
key.help: Song key (gfx-pitch's id); golem sets it per song

spread.name: Spread
spread.help: 2 / 2 only: even bands left, odd bands right

model.name: Model
model.help: The wah circuit whose sweep, Q and voicing are played

mix.name: Mix
mix.help: Wet level against the dry signal (100 % = wah only)

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: Manual = the pedal sweeps; auto = the envelope sweeps; alien = both

taper.name: Taper
taper.help: How the pedal travel maps onto the sweep; Model = the circuit's own pot

toe.name: Toe
toe.help: Where the sweep ends at toe down (percent of the full range)

auto_engage.name: Auto Engage
auto_engage.help: Switches the wah on when the pedal moves, off when it rests at heel

engage_wait.name: Engage Wait
engage_wait.help: How long the pedal must rest at heel before the wah switches off

env_sens.name: Envelope Sensitivity
env_sens.help: How strongly playing dynamics move the sweep (auto and alien modes)

env_att.name: Envelope Attack
env_att.help: How fast the envelope follows a louder note

env_rel.name: Envelope Release
env_rel.help: How fast the envelope falls back after the note

mode.name: Mode
mode.help: The side generator: Velvet (fine, irregular width), Allpass (no smear, broad colour), Comb (pseudo-stereo), Double (micro-shift), M/S (a stereo source's own width only)

amount.name: Amount
amount.help: Level of the generated side re the mid; 100 % = correlation 0 on a mono source

width.name: Width
width.help: Master side gain (source side and generated); 0 % = mono, 100 % = neutral for a stereo source

time.name: Time
time.help: Velvet length (10 - 40 ms), Comb delay, Double delay; inert in Allpass and M/S

bass_keep.name: Bass Keep
bass_keep.help: Below it the output is mono and dry (a high-pass on the side only); 0 = off

mono_law.name: Mono Law
mono_law.help: Exact: the mono fold is the dry. Classic: true Haas (Comb) and L / R voices (Double); inert elsewhere

variant.name: Variant
variant.help: Which velvet sequence or all-pass set: two lanes on two variants stay distinct

cents.name: Detune
cents.help: Double: each voice is shifted up and down by this much

high_cut.name: Side High Cut
high_cut.help: Low-pass on the generated side only: keeps sibilants and pick noise centred

transient.name: Transient Focus
transient.help: Ducks the generated side on attacks: the pick stays centred, the sustain blooms wide

balance.name: Balance
balance.help: Places the image (positive = right) without touching the mono fold

rotate.name: Rotation
rotate.help: Rotates a stereo image (positive = right); moves the mono fold

listen.name: Listen
listen.help: Audition the mono fold or the side alone (not stored by golem)
